title: Exchangeability of the correlated pair
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $\rho\in[-1,1]$, and let $(X,Y)$ be the correlated pair of sign vectors on $\{\pm1\}^n$ obtained by choosing $X$ uniformly and applying independent coordinate noise with retention probability $(1+\rho)/2$. The law of $(Y,X)$ equals the law of $(X,Y)$.
